observations: Manual treadle sewing machine mounted in a wooden cabinet/table with a cast-iron treadle base and flywheel.
Machine head is off-white/cream with chrome dials, badge visible reading 'MERCURY' (photo 1, photo 2).
Visible paint chipping and wear on the machine body, especially near the front and side (photo 1, photo 3).
Some rust-colored staining on the metal body near the front plate (photo 1, photo 2).
Wooden table/cabinet has scuffed, worn red-brown paint on edges and corners (photo 3).
Treadle base and flywheel show surface rust and wear (photo 2, photo 3).
Photos taken outdoors on a shop porch; no video or sound to confirm operation.
No clear shot of a model number plate beyond the 'Mercury' brand name.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 and photo 3 show visible paint chipping, rust spotting, and worn table edges, inconsistent with 'perfect condition'.

risks.risk: Mechanical function of the sewing machine (needle movement, bobbin, tension, treadle action) cannot be confirmed from static photos.
risks.proof: A short video of the treadle being pedaled and the needle/arm moving, ideally stitching on fabric.

risks.risk: Rust or corrosion inside the mechanism (not just surface) could prevent smooth operation.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the internal gear area and bobbin case with cover removed.

risks.risk: Belt (drive band) condition and presence not shown clearly; missing or frayed belt would stop operation.
risks.proof: Photo clearly showing the belt loop connecting the flywheel to the machine pulley.

risks.risk: Table/cabinet structural integrity (hinges, drawers, legs) not fully verifiable from angles shown.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside of the table and close-up of hinges and drawer slides.

proof_requests: Video of the treadle being pedaled and the machine stitching on a piece of fabric.
Close-up of the brand/model plate for exact identification.
Photo of the belt connecting the flywheel to the machine head.
Photo of the underside of the table and the drawer/hinge mechanisms.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Mercury-branded treadle sewing machine with table; since the 'perfect condition' claim is contradicted by visible wear and function cannot be verified remotely, it must be priced at worst case as a non-working, cosmetically worn unit.
